main_text.head:
Cap. 5. De augmento syllabi-
co, & primó in de-
rivatis.
main_text.p: Si thema incipit á consonante, præponitur ε, & id incrementum dicitur syllabicum, quia verbum crescit syllaba: ut τιμάω, ἐτίμαον, colo, colebam.
Derivatum á nomine, est regulare: χαλκυρ-γὸν recéns factum: hinc χαλκυργέω ἐχαλκυργέον, nova molior, bar.
καλλιγραφὸς, qui pulchré scribit: hinc καλλιγραφέω ἐκαλλιγράφεον, pulchré scribo, bam.

page.notes: Greek text is partly degraded and transcribed approximately; the Greek accents and letters in several words are uncertain. The foot mark "k ÿ" is a signature-type mark and is not transcribed as text.
